answer: Because the atlas collateral is checked against the haven claim at intake, the mesa audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases hence has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Posted collateral must equal 6 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 37 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
